rating-bot.title: rating_bot
description: A production Telegram bot that provides personalized content recommendations using machine learning. Users rate items on a 1-10 scale, and the system learns their preferences to suggest new content they are likely to enjoy.

Built with hexagonal architecture to keep business logic independent of external services. The recommendation engine uses collaborative filtering and content-based approaches, with Redis caching for fast response times under load.
Features multi-language support (English and Russian), comprehensive monitoring via Prometheus and Grafana dashboards, and a full CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and deployment.
highlights: ML-based recommendation engine with collaborative filtering
Hexagonal architecture separating domain logic from infrastructure
Prometheus + Grafana monitoring with custom metrics
Multi-language support with dynamic locale switching
CI/CD pipeline with automated testing and Docker deployment
Redis caching layer for sub-100ms response times

rule-indicators.title: Industrial Rule Indicators
description: A multi-mode industrial display system deployed on real manufacturing machinery. The device shows critical operational data on 7-segment displays: current time, ambient temperature, and accumulated motor/spindle running hours.

Designed for harsh industrial environments with reliable RTC timekeeping and DS18B20 temperature sensing. The system tracks machine usage hours for preventive maintenance scheduling, helping operators know when equipment service is due.
Built with modular C++ architecture on Arduino, allowing easy addition of new display modes. The project includes a Wokwi simulation for testing without physical hardware.
highlights: Real-time clock (RTC) with battery backup for accurate timekeeping
DS18B20 temperature monitoring with configurable alerts
Motor and spindle hour tracking for maintenance scheduling
7-segment display with multiple operating modes
Deployed on real industrial machinery in production
Wokwi simulation available for testing and demonstration

media-viewer.title: Media Viewer
description: An Electron desktop application for browsing, rating, and organizing media files. The app provides a clean interface for viewing images and videos, with the ability to rate content and track viewing history.

Features an ML-based preference learning system that analyzes user ratings to understand visual preferences. The similarity sorting algorithm groups visually related content together, making it easier to find and organize media.
Built as a cross-platform desktop app using Electron, with a focus on performance when handling large media libraries containing thousands of files.
highlights: ML-based visual preference learning from user ratings
Visual similarity sorting for intelligent content grouping
Cross-platform desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux)
Efficient handling of large media libraries (10,000+ files)
Rating system with persistent user preference tracking
Keyboard-driven navigation for fast browsing

lubrication.title: Automatic Machine Lubrication
description: An Arduino-based automatic lubrication system designed for industrial machinery. The system handles timer-controlled oil dispensing with configurable intervals, ensuring equipment receives proper lubrication without manual intervention.

Features a manual override button for immediate lubrication when needed, along with a floater sensor that monitors oil tank levels in real time. LED indicators provide clear visual feedback on oil status, so operators can tell at a glance whether the tank needs refilling.

The timer state persists across power cycles via EEPROM storage, making the system reliable in factory environments where unexpected shutdowns occur. A debug mode with serial output aids in troubleshooting during installation.
highlights: Timer-based automatic lubrication with configurable intervals
Manual override button for immediate oil dispensing
Oil level monitoring via floater sensor with LED indicators
EEPROM state persistence across power cycles
MOSFET-controlled oil pump motor for reliable operation
Wokwi simulation available for testing without hardware

hx711-scale.title: HX711 Multi-Scale System
description: A multi-channel weighing system connecting 8 HX711 load cell amplifiers to a single Arduino Nano. The system supports individual sensor calibration with known weights, tare functionality, and real-time weight readings via serial communication.

Calibration values are stored in EEPROM so sensors retain their calibration across power cycles. The serial interface provides interactive commands for calibrating, taring, loading saved values, and reading current weights from all channels simultaneously.

Built for industrial and lab environments where multiple weighing points need to be monitored from a single controller. Includes a Wokwi simulation for development and testing without physical hardware.
highlights: 8 HX711 load cell amplifiers on a single Arduino Nano
Interactive serial calibration with known weight input
EEPROM persistence for calibration values across restarts
Tare functionality with configurable tolerance thresholds
Ready-state checks prevent code blocking on disconnected sensors
Wokwi simulation for development and testing

dropshipping.title: E-commerce Prototype
description: A full-stack dropshipping e-commerce platform built with Next.js 14 App Router. Features a customer storefront with product browsing, search, filters, shopping cart, and Stripe checkout, plus an admin panel for product and order management.

The platform supports hierarchical categories, product reviews with verified purchase validation, newsletter subscriptions with double opt-in, and automated order forwarding to suppliers via background job processing with BullMQ and Redis.

Includes comprehensive SEO features (dynamic Open Graph images, JSON-LD structured data, Google Shopping feed), GA4 analytics tracking, GDPR-compliant cookie consent, and a test suite with 249 unit tests and E2E coverage.
highlights: Customer storefront with search, filters, cart, and Stripe payments
Admin panel for products, orders, reviews, and newsletter management
Background job processing with BullMQ and Redis
SEO: server-side rendering, OG images, JSON-LD, Google Shopping feed
249 unit tests plus Playwright E2E coverage (~90% statements)
CI/CD with GitHub Actions and dual deployment (Vercel/VPS)

svg-processor.title: SVG Layer Processor
description: A Python command-line tool for processing multi-layer SVG files exported from Kiri:Moto, a web-based 3D printing slicer. The tool automatically numbers each layer and converts the result into paginated A4 PDF documents.

The workflow has three stages: first, it parses SVG path elements and adds visible layer numbers at each path's starting point. Then it converts the numbered SVG to a full-length PDF using CairoSVG. Finally, it splits the long PDF into standard A4 pages using ReportLab.

Supports configurable font size, text color, and number positioning via command-line arguments. Designed to handle files with hundreds of layers — tested with 525-layer SVGs producing 27+ page A4 documents.
highlights: Automatic layer numbering for multi-layer SVG files
High-quality SVG to PDF conversion via CairoSVG
Intelligent A4 page splitting with correct vertical offsets
Configurable font size, color, and position via CLI arguments
Handles 500+ layer files producing dozens of A4 pages
Built for Kiri:Moto 3D printing slicer workflow

cleanspark.title: CleanSpark
description: A multi-theme cleaning business website built with Astro 5, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS 4. Features 5 radically different design themes — not CSS variable swaps, but complete layout systems with unique component structures, animations, typography, and UX patterns. Full MVP delivered in one week.

Each theme is a self-contained design system: Minimal Zen (warm neutrals, Apple-like simplicity), Bold Spark (vibrant geometric energy), Trust Shield (corporate professionalism), Bubbly Clean (playful pastels), and Noir Luxe (dark luxury elegance). Themes switch in real time with cookie-based persistence and server-side rendering.

Built with Astro’s islands architecture — static HTML by default, JavaScript only for interactive components. Includes 962 automated tests (78 unit + 218 E2E across 4 browsers), WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance verified with axe-core across all 30 theme/page combinations.
highlights: 5 complete design themes with unique layouts, animations, and typography
Real-time theme switching with SSR and cookie persistence
962 automated tests across 4 browsers (Vitest + Playwright)
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility verified across all 30 theme/page combinations
Islands architecture — static HTML by default, JS only where needed
Full MVP delivered in one week
